title: Autonomous Uncertainty Quantification for Discontinuous Models Using Multivariate Padé Approximations
first_author_affiliation: Uncertainty Quantification Lab, Department of Aeronautics Imperial College London, London SW7 2AZ, UK e-mail:

corresponding_authors.name: Richard Ahlfeld
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Uncertainty Quantification Lab, Department of Aeronautics Imperial College London, London SW7 2AZ, UK e-mail:

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多元Padé近似与不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbomachinery CFD with discontinuous responses, not on biomedical FEA surrogate modeling or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决不连续响应模型的不确定性量化可靠性问题
summary_zh.method: 结合多元Padé-Legendre近似、最优求积子采样和统计学习
summary_zh.result: 仅用9次CFD模拟即可准确拟合数千个不连续响应面
summary_zh.validation: 在工业气膜冷却和激波干扰问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To ensure reliable uncertainty quantification for discontinuous and nonlinear responses in turbomachinery CFD with limited model evaluations.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach combining multivariate Padé-Legendre approximations, optimal quadrature subsampling, and statistical learning for smoothness and convergence checking.
summary_en.result: The method accurately fits thousands of partially discontinuous response surfaces using only nine CFD simulations for an industrial film cooling and shock interaction problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an industrial film cooling and shock interaction CFD problem with discontinuous response surfaces.

key_terms.zh: 涡轮机械计算流体动力学

title: Scalable Gaussian process-based transfer surrogates for hyperparameter optimization
first_author_affiliation: Information Systems and Machine Learning Lab, Universitätsplatz 1, Hildesheim, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Martin Wistuba
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Information Systems and Machine Learning Lab, Universitätsplatz 1, Hildesheim, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出可扩展的高斯过程迁移代理模型用于超参数优化，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hyperparameter optimization in machine learning, not on expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决超参数优化中代理模型的可扩展性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出可扩展的高斯过程迁移代理模型，利用多任务学习
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试中显著提升优化效率
summary_zh.validation: 在标准机器学习基准数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the scalability of surrogate models in hyperparameter optimization by leveraging transfer learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes a scalable Gaussian process-based transfer surrogate that shares knowledge across tasks via multi-task learning.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates significant improvement in optimization efficiency on several benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard machine learning benchmark datasets.

title: A novel approach to in-situ fabricate Ti-6Al-4V alloy with graded microstructure and property by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Zemin Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, PR China

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V梯度组织，虽未直接研究应力遮挡或疲劳性能，但梯度设计方法可转移至生物医用植入体刚度匹配。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding quantification, fatigue testing, or surface characterization for osseointegration in the context of biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过原位调控实现SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V合金的梯度组织与性能
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化工艺原位制造具有梯度显微组织的钛合金试样
summary_zh.result: 成功获得沿构建方向梯度变化的微观结构与力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 对梯度试样进行微观组织表征与力学性能测试

summary_en.motivation: To develop an in-situ method during selective laser melting for fabricating Ti-6Al-4V alloy with graded microstructure and mechanical properties tailored for specific applications.
summary_en.method: The study employs selective laser melting with process parameter variations to achieve a gradual transition in microstructure along the build direction.
summary_en.result: The fabricated samples exhibit a graded microstructure from martensitic to lamellar α+β, leading to a gradient in hardness and tensile properties.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization (SEM, EBSD) and mechanical testing (hardness, tensile) were performed to validate the graded structure and property variations.

title: Transhumeral loading during advanced upper extremity activities of daily living
first_author_affiliation: Department of Bioengineering, University of Utah, Salt Lake City, Utah, United States of America

corresponding_authors.name: Heath B. Henninger
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Bioengineering, University of Utah, Salt Lake City, Utah, United States of America

corresponding_authors.name: K. Bo Foreman
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, University of Utah, Salt Lake City, Utah, United States of America

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了经肱骨载荷数据，可用于髋关节植入物研究中载荷边界条件的设定。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on transhumeral loading for upper extremity prosthetics, not on hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or femoral stem mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 获取经肱载荷数据以设计过载保护装置，降低假体周围骨折风险。
summary_zh.method: 采集非截肢者上肢运动学数据，通过逆动力学计算不同截肢水平的轴向力、弯矩和扭矩。
summary_zh.result: 近端截肢水平载荷显著更高，跳跃运动产生最大轴向力（174.5N）和弯矩（57.6Nm）。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，载荷与尸体研究中的固定失效载荷对比。

summary_en.motivation: To collect transhumeral loading data for designing overload protection devices and reducing periprosthetic fracture risk in osseointegrated implants.
summary_en.method: Marker-based kinematic data from non-amputee volunteers during advanced activities of daily living were analyzed using inverse dynamics to compute axial forces, bending and torsional moments at three virtual amputation levels.
summary_en.result: Proximal amputation levels experienced significantly higher loads; jumping jacks produced peak axial force (174.5N) and bending moment (57.6Nm).
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; calculated loads were compared to cadaveric implant fixation failure loads.

title: Scalable hierarchical PDE sampler for generating spatially correlated random fields using non-matching meshes
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过非匹配网格嵌入高效生成随机场，适用于大规模不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的采样效率提升。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant or biomechanics design; its application is limited to subsurface flow problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模不确定性量化中高效生成随机场
summary_zh.method: 非匹配网格嵌入结合反应扩散PDE求解生成高斯随机场
summary_zh.result: 实现千万未知量级别三维并行采样
summary_zh.validation: 地下水流问题多层级蒙特卡洛数值实验

summary_en.motivation: Efficient generation of spatially correlated random fields for large-scale uncertainty quantification in PDEs.
summary_en.method: A scalable hierarchical sampling method that generates Gaussian random fields by solving a stochastic reaction-diffusion PDE on an embedded structured mesh and projecting onto an unstructured mesh.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated parallel scalability for 3D multilevel Monte Carlo simulations with up to 1.9 billion unknowns.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a subsurface flow problem using multilevel Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification.

title: Parametric study of surface morphology for selective laser melting on Ti6Al4V powder bed with numerical and experimental methods
first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan City, 701, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Yu-Che Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan City, 701, Taiwan

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM工艺参数对Ti6Al4V表面形貌的影响，与生物医学植入物表面改性相关，但未涉及多孔结构和应力遮挡。
why_not_core: Does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, mechanical testing (fatigue/compression), or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对Ti6Al4V表面形貌的影响规律
summary_zh.method: 采用数值模拟与实验表征相结合的方法进行参数化研究
summary_zh.result: 确定了影响表面粗糙度的关键工艺参数
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量表面形貌验证模拟结果

summary_en.motivation: Parametric study to investigate how selective laser melting process parameters affect the surface morphology of Ti6Al4V powder bed parts.
summary_en.method: Combined numerical simulation and experimental characterization to systematically vary parameters and measure resulting surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Identified key parameters that significantly influence surface roughness and optimized process conditions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental surface morphology measurements validated the numerical predictions.

title: Local-global model reduction method for stochastic optimal control problems constrained by partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对含不确定性的偏微分方程约束的最优控制问题提出局部-全局模型降阶，可转移至植入物/生物力学设计中昂贵的仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it involve contact mechanics or in-silico trials.

summary_zh.motivation: 随机最优控制问题计算昂贵，需高效降阶方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部-全局模型降阶，融合约化基与广义多尺度有限元。
summary_zh.result: 数值算例表明效率高，在线计算快且可并行。
summary_zh.validation: 多组随机最优控制数值实例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Stochastic optimal control problems constrained by PDEs are computationally prohibitive due to the need for a large number of samples to quantify uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A local-global model reduction method is developed by combining the reduced basis method and the Generalized Multiscale Finite Element Method (GMsFEM) to accelerate the solution of the optimality system.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves significant computational savings, with most steps independent and fast online computation for each random sample.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples for various stochastic optimal control problems demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the reduction method.

title: Additive Manufacturing of Titanium Alloys by Electron Beam Melting: A Review
first_author_affiliation: School of Engineering Edith Cowan University 270 Joondalup Drive, Joondalup Perth, WA 6027 Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Lai‐Chang Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Engineering Edith Cowan University 270 Joondalup Drive, Joondalup Perth, WA 6027 Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Yujing Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Engineering Edith Cowan University 270 Joondalup Drive, Joondalup Perth, WA 6027 Australia

relevance_to_user: 该综述涵盖了EBM制造钛合金的工艺、微观结构和性能，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合等生物力学匹配问题。
why_not_core: This is a general review of EBM for titanium alloys, not specifically addressing porous structure design for stress shielding reduction, LPBF fabrication, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述电子束熔化技术制造钛合金的进展
summary_zh.method: 回顾EBM工艺、微观结构及性能研究
summary_zh.result: EBM可制造高致密度钛合金，具有独特微观结构和良好力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 引用文献总结，无新实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To review the state-of-the-art in electron beam melting of titanium alloys, covering processing, microstructure, and properties.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive literature review of EBM process parameters, resulting microstructures, and mechanical/corrosion properties of titanium alloys and composites.
summary_en.result: EBM produces titanium alloys with higher density than SLM, unique microstructures, and competitive mechanical properties including fatigue and corrosion resistance.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper synthesizes findings from prior studies.

title: Porous Titanium Associated with CaP Coating: In Vivo and In Vitro Osteogenic Performance
first_author_affiliation: Universidade Estadual Paulista, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Luana Marotta Reis de Vasconcellos
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Universidade Estadual Paulista, Brazil

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔钛植入物与CaP涂层对成骨性能的影响，但未涉及LPBF制造、疲劳测试或应力屏蔽分析。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多孔钛与CaP涂层对骨整合的影响
summary_zh.method: 粉末冶金制备不同孔隙率钛样品，结合CaP涂层，进行体外细胞实验和兔体内植入
summary_zh.result: 40%孔隙率+CaP涂层促进矿化基质形成和骨-植入物接触
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和兔胫骨体内植入组织学评估

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the osteogenic performance of porous titanium implants with and without CaP coating.
summary_en.method: Titanium samples with dense, 30%, and 40% porosity were fabricated by powder metallurgy, coated with CaP, and tested in vitro with rat osteogenic cells and in vivo in rabbit tibiae.
summary_en.result: CaP coating combined with 40% porosity enhanced mineralized matrix formation in vitro and increased bone-implant contact in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays (adhesion, ALP, mineralization) and in vivo histomorphometry in rabbits.

title: Safe Policy Search with Gaussian Process Models
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程模型进行安全策略搜索，具有不确定性量化和约束处理能力，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on robotics control rather than surrogate modeling for FEA or implant biomechanics; it does not validate on structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 在数据有限的情况下安全地优化控制策略
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程模型进行策略搜索，利用解析梯度估计违反约束的概率
summary_zh.result: 实现了数据高效且安全的策略优化
summary_zh.validation: 在仿真环境中验证了方法的有效性

summary_en.motivation: To safely optimize control policy parameters in a data-efficient manner under constraints.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process model approximates system dynamics, enabling closed-form computation of error gradients and constraint violation probability.
summary_en.result: The method achieves data-efficient safe policy search with guaranteed constraint satisfaction during training and operation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on simulated control tasks with constraint handling.

title: Random forward models and log-likelihoods in Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 本文为贝叶斯反问题中随机代理模型提供了理论基础，可迁移至有限元代理建模的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper is purely theoretical with no application to biomechanics, implant design, or constraints handling; it does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency in a practical sense.

summary_zh.motivation: 为随机代理模型在贝叶斯反问题中的使用提供稳定性保证。
summary_zh.method: 通过分析精确与近似后验之间的Hellinger距离，建立其与对数似然差矩的界限。
summary_zh.result: 证明了Hellinger距离受对数似然差矩的控制，为随机近似提供了理论依据。
summary_zh.validation: 给出大数据和常微分方程概率求解的示例应用。

summary_en.motivation: To provide stability guarantees for the use of randomized surrogates in Bayesian inverse problems.
summary_en.method: Bound the Hellinger distance between exact and approximate posteriors in terms of moments of the log-likelihood difference.
summary_en.result: The Hellinger distance is controlled by moments of the log-likelihood error, supporting the theoretical foundation of stochastic approximations.
summary_en.validation: Example applications in large-data misfit models and probabilistic solution of ODEs are provided.

title: Practical Bayesian optimization in the presence of outliers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法可提高代理模型在异常值存在下的采样效率，但未涉及多目标约束或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical design tasks; it focuses on general Bayesian optimization with outliers.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化对异常值敏感，导致采样偏差。
summary_zh.method: 结合学生-t似然GP与异常值诊断调度算法。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在异常值存在时收敛更快且结果更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准函数上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from biased inference when outliers contaminate the surrogate model's training data.
summary_en.method: A robust Bayesian optimization method that combines a Gaussian process with Student-t likelihood and a scheduler for outlier classification.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms standard robust regression baselines in both convergence speed and final solution quality on synthetic benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic benchmark functions with injected outliers.

title: Repositioning Titanium: An In Vitro Evaluation of Laser-Generated Microporous, Microrough Titanium Templates As a Potential Bridging Interface for Enhanced Osseointegration and Durability of Implants
first_author_affiliation: Centre for Human Development, Stem Cells and Regeneration, Faculty of Medicine, University of Southampton, Southampton, United Kingdom

corresponding_authors.name: Keng‐Liang Ou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: 3D Global Biotech Inc., New Taipei City, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Richard O. C. Oreffo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Human Development, Stem Cells and Regeneration, Faculty of Medicine, University of Southampton, Southampton, United Kingdom

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光生成的多孔钛模板对骨整合的影响，但缺乏力学测试和应力遮挡分析。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no linking of porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决钛合金植入物因骨整合不足而失效的问题。
summary_zh.method: 用激光制备微孔粗糙钛模板，在其上培养人骨骼干细胞，观察成骨分化。
summary_zh.result: 细胞粘附强，早期成骨分化，但迁移和向内生长受限。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验，21天培养评估骨整合能力。

summary_en.motivation: To address inadequate osseointegration in titanium implants that leads to early failure within 15 years.
summary_en.method: A laser-generated microporous, microrough medical grade IV titanium template was used to culture human skeletal stem cells in inverted basal conditions for 21 days.
summary_en.result: Cells showed strong adherence and early osteogenic differentiation, but limited migration and ingrowth due to pore geometry and wettability.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture with human SSCs over 21 days, assessing adhesion, differentiation, and migration.

title: Morphology and properties of CoCrMo parts fabricated by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yongqiang Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, China

corresponding_authors.name: Di Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, China

relevance_to_user: 本文研究了选区激光熔化CoCrMo合金的形貌与力学性能，作为植入物制造的基础材料研究具有参考价值。
why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, lacks fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对CoCrMo合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同激光参数制备样品，通过SEM、XRD和力学测试表征。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数与致密度、硬度和拉伸性能的关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试和微观结构观察验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of selective laser melting parameters on the morphology and mechanical properties of CoCrMo alloy.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated with varying laser parameters and characterized via SEM, XRD, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Correlations between processing parameters, density, hardness, and tensile properties were established.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization and mechanical testing.

title: Constrained Gaussian process with application in tissue-engineering scaffold biodegradation
first_author_affiliation: Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A & M University, College Station, TX, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Li Zeng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A & M University, College Station, TX, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束高斯过程方法可用于生物制造中的预测建模，其处理专家知识（如单调性、边界）的能力可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 组织工程支架降解预测需融入专家知识，传统方法难以处理约束。
summary_zh.method: 提出约束高斯过程（CGP），统一处理删失、单调性和边界约束。
summary_zh.result: CGP比无约束GP和神经网络预测更准确、更有意义。
summary_zh.validation: 通过支架降解案例和仿真研究验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Predicting biodegradation in tissue-engineering scaffolds requires incorporating expert knowledge, which is challenging for standard methods.
summary_en.method: A Constrained Gaussian Process (CGP) is proposed to unify censoring, monotonicity, and bound constraints in predictive modeling.
summary_en.result: CGP provides more accurate and meaningful predictions compared to unconstrained GP and artificial neural networks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through a case study on scaffold fabrication and a simulation study.

title: Shape optimization in laminar flow with a label-guided variational autoencoder
relevance_to_user: 该论文将变分自编码器与高斯过程回归结合用于形状优化，可迁移到植入物设计中的代理建模与贝叶斯优化问题。
why_not_core: No constraints handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond GP variance, and no biomechanics or implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 使用贝叶斯优化最小化层流中物体的阻力，避免求解昂贵的PDE。
summary_zh.method: 联合训练变分自编码器和高斯过程回归，从形状预测阻力并优化。
summary_zh.result: 生成的二维形状显著降低了阻力系数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维层流数值模拟验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to minimize drag in laminar flow using Bayesian optimization to avoid repeatedly solving expensive PDEs for each candidate shape.
summary_en.method: A variational autoencoder (VAE) maps shapes to a latent space, on which Gaussian process regression predicts drag, enabling efficient Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: The approach generates improved shapes with significantly lower drag compared to the initial designs.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical simulation of 2D laminar flows.

title: Variational Inference over Non-differentiable Cardiac Simulators using Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用贝叶斯优化对昂贵心脏模拟器进行参数推断，可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA for implant design, structural mechanics constraints, or multi-objective optimization; it focuses on parameter inference for a cardiac electrophysiology simulator.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决心脏模拟器参数推断计算昂贵且无法计算边际似然的问题
summary_zh.method: 使用贝叶斯优化的无似然推断方法校准模拟器参数
summary_zh.result: 改善了对真实患者心电图的拟合效果
summary_zh.validation: 通过真实患者心电图数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable inference over computationally expensive cardiac simulators where marginal likelihood is intractable
summary_en.method: Developed a likelihood-free inference approach using Bayesian optimization to calibrate simulator parameters
summary_en.result: Improved the fit of a state-of-the-art cardiac simulator to a real patient's electrocardiogram
summary_en.validation: Validated by fitting simulator output to clinical ECG recordings from a real patient

title: Multiple Adaptive Bayesian Linear Regression for Scalable Bayesian Optimization with Warm Start
relevance_to_user: 该方法可扩展贝叶斯优化到大规模历史数据，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或在生物力学设计中的应用。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no explicit uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO, and no demonstration on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程贝叶斯优化计算复杂度高、难以利用大量历史数据的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出多自适应贝叶斯线性回归模型，通过共享神经网络耦合多个模型实现迁移学习。
summary_zh.result: 模型复杂度与观测数线性相关，能利用相关函数评估加速优化。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准优化函数上测试，与GP-BO比较性能。

summary_en.motivation: To scale Bayesian optimization to large datasets by replacing the cubic-complexity Gaussian process with a linear-complexity model that can leverage past evaluations.
summary_en.method: Proposes multiple adaptive Bayesian linear regression models coupled through a shared feedforward neural network for transfer learning across optimization tasks.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves linear time complexity in the number of observations and effectively transfers knowledge to warm-start optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark optimization functions, demonstrating competitive performance with standard GP-based BO.

why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估水文系统参数对输出概率分布各阶矩的影响
summary_zh.method: 提出基于矩的全局敏感性指标，结合广义多项式混沌展开代理模型
summary_zh.result: 不同参数对不同统计矩的影响不同，代理模型精度需根据矩阶数调整
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析基准、海岸含水层抽水模拟和实验室示踪实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To assess the impact of uncertain parameters on different statistical moments of model output in hydrological systems.
summary_en.method: Proposes moment-based global sensitivity metrics coupled with generalized polynomial chaos expansion surrogate.
summary_en.result: Parameters influential on one moment may be uninfluential on others; surrogate accuracy requirements depend on the moment considered.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an analytical benchmark, a coastal aquifer pumping scenario, and a laboratory-scale transport experiment.

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization; it focuses on structural health monitoring under operational variability.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决环境与操作条件变化下结构振动响应建模的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于高斯过程回归的随机系数时间序列模型。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of modeling structural vibration responses under varying environmental and operational conditions.
summary_en.method: A stochastic modeling methodology using Gaussian process time-series models with random coefficients regressed on environmental parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed GP time-series models effectively track variations in modal quantities driven by changes in average wind speed.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three-year vertical vibration data from the Humber bridge and long-term simulated wind turbine response.

summary_zh.method: 对Ti-6Al-4V部件进行拓扑优化并采用EB-PBF工艺制造。

summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证部件性能。

summary_en.motivation: To demonstrate the feasibility of fabricating topology-optimized Ti-6Al-4V components via electron beam powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Topology optimization was applied to design Ti-6Al-4V components, which were then manufactured using electron beam powder bed fusion.
summary_en.result: The topology-optimized components were successfully fabricated with satisfactory mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing was conducted to validate the performance of the fabricated components.

title: Inverse modeling of hydrologic systems with adaptive multi-fidelity Markov chain Monte Carlo simulations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过多保真度和高斯过程加速MCMC采样，可迁移到植入物生物力学设计中的不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: It is applied to hydrologic inverse modeling, not implant or biomechanics FEA, and does not address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少高计算成本水文模型MCMC采样的计算负担
summary_zh.method: 自适应构建多保真高斯过程代理，并在后验区域迭代运行MCMC
summary_zh.result: 少量高保真评估即可准确估计后验分布
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个水文逆问题数值案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of MCMC sampling for CPU-intensive hydrologic models by leveraging multi-fidelity simulations.
summary_en.method: An adaptive multi-fidelity MCMC algorithm that iteratively builds a Gaussian process surrogate and runs MCMC, with the error of the GP system rigorously considered and reduced in the posterior region.
summary_en.result: Accurate posterior distributions are obtained with a small number of high-fidelity model evaluations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on three numerical case studies of inverse modeling in hydrologic systems.

title: Tensor Approximation of Advanced Metrics for Sensitivity Analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供的张量灵敏度分析框架可用于FE代理模型的不确定性量化，但未直接处理约束或多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply sensitivity analysis to FEA or biomechanical design, does not handle constraints, and lacks validation on real-world engineering problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出张量方法计算高级灵敏度指标。
summary_zh.method: 利用张量列分解和自动机掩码高效聚合Sobol指数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个示例模型上验证了计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值示例模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: Propose tensor-based algorithms to efficiently compute advanced sensitivity metrics such as effective dimensions and Shapley values.
summary_en.method: Use tensor train decomposition and deterministic finite automata masks to aggregate Sobol indices directly in the compressed tensor domain.
summary_en.result: Demonstrate computational efficiency across several analytical test models, enabling the computation of metrics that would otherwise be infeasible.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark models, showing accurate and scalable computation of sensitivity metrics.

title: Robust Optimization Approaches for the Design of an Electric Machine
relevance_to_user: 该论文的鲁棒优化与不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型与约束优化场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, bone mechanics, or structural biomechanics; it focuses on electromagnetic optimization of electric machines.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高电机设计中永磁体尺寸在参数偏差下的鲁棒性
summary_zh.method: 采用最坏情况与基于UQ的两种鲁棒优化，结合模型降阶提升效率
summary_zh.result: UQ方法较最坏情况优化更不保守，得到更小的永磁体尺寸
summary_zh.validation: 通过电机仿真案例对比两种优化算法

summary_en.motivation: To improve the robustness of permanent magnet sizing in electric machine design under parameter deviations.
summary_en.method: Two robust optimization formulations (worst-case and UQ-based) are combined with model order reduction to handle expensive PDE-constrained evaluations.
summary_en.result: The UQ-based approach yields smaller magnets and is less pessimistic than worst-case optimization.
summary_en.validation: The optimization algorithms are demonstrated on an electric machine simulation case.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of optimizing bioprocess conditions in a perfusion bioreactor.
summary_en.method: A 3D mechanistic model was reduced to a set of ordinary differential equations, and Bayesian optimization was applied to find optimal medium refreshment regimes.
summary_en.result: High-frequency and high-percentage medium replacement maximized neotissue growth kinetics over 21 days.

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization often over-explores the boundary of the search space, wasting evaluations when the optimum is interior.
summary_en.method: Virtual derivative sign observations are incorporated into the Gaussian process at the boundary to penalize boundary exploration.
summary_en.result: The proposed method consistently reduces the number of evaluations required to find the optimum across various acquisition functions.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on synthetic benchmark functions demonstrate the improvement.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服高斯过程训练中O(N^3)的计算瓶颈，实现可扩展推理。
summary_zh.method: 采用混合专家模型结合低维矩阵求逆和重要性采样，实现可并行化推理。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the O(N^3) computational bottleneck in Gaussian process training and enable scalable inference.
summary_en.method: A mixture-of-experts model combining low-dimensional matrix inversions with importance sampling for embarrassingly parallel inference.
summary_en.result: Achieves comparable performance to standard GP regression at a much lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard regression datasets.

summary_zh.result: 通过点云分布继承自然组织分布，可调控结构参数。

summary_en.motivation: Current modeling techniques for porous bone implants lack sufficient control over mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: A novel method combining implicit surface modeling and Voronoi diagram is proposed to generate randomized porous structures with controllable strut thickness and density.
summary_en.result: The proposed data acquisition method simplifies CT images to point clouds, and the distribution of point clouds inherits natural tissue distribution to guide porous structure generation.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper only describes the method conceptually.
